title: La Trajinera de Xochimilco, MEXI STORIES
comment: trajinera-xochimilco (MEXI): embarcadero de trajineras y chinampa en Xochimilco, Ciudad de México. Caras comunes, no famosas; los cuatro se distinguen a simple vista.

chars.ABRIL_NAVARRO: Mexican woman from Mexico City, trajinera rower, 25 years old, brown skin, shoulder-length wavy black hair, a white tank top under an open red flannel shirt, rolled-up jeans, sandals, her hands empty.
chars.RUBEN_ARCE: Mexican man, 40 years old, light-brown skin, shaved bald head, a black goatee, dark sunglasses on his head, a black polo shirt, a gold watch, beige trousers, black shoes, his hands empty.
chars.CELSO_MONTES: Mexican boss from Mexico City, 68 years old, heavy-set, light skin, white hair, a thick white mustache, a grey flat cap, a dark-green bomber jacket over a white shirt, a gold ring, dark trousers, his hands empty.
chars.TEODORO_NAVARRO: Mexican grandfather from Xochimilco, 80 years old, very thin, brown wrinkled skin, a short white beard, a worn straw hat, a loose white cotton shirt, rolled-up grey trousers, sandals, his hands empty.

locs.LOC_EMBARCADERO: Trajinera pier in Xochimilco, Mexico City, in the late afternoon: a wooden dock on a green canal with many colorful wooden trajinera boats with painted floral arches, tall ahuejote trees along the water, flowers, warm light, no readable text, no signs, no names painted on the boats, no logos, no people.
locs.LOC_CHINAMPA: Humble house on a chinampa in Xochimilco at dusk: a small wooden dock on a quiet canal, an old faded wooden trajinera boat with a peeling painted floral arch tied there, vegetable beds and flowers, a lantern hanging on a post, ahuejote trees, warm light, no readable text, no signs, no names painted on the boat, no logos, no people.
